content.title: Hattie the Hedgehog's Happy Wait
content.newWordMeaning: Patient means waiting kindly, without fussing.
content.message: Waiting kindly can bring lovely things.

characters.name: Hattie
characters.look: A small round hedgehog with soft brown spines, a cream tummy and a pink nose.

characters.name: Bramble
characters.look: A grey rabbit with long floppy ears and a white tail.

content.setting: An apple orchard at sunset and dusk.

spreads.text: Hattie the hedgehog loved the orchard at sunset. The apples glowed like little lamps, and the grass was soft and warm.
spreads.sceneSummary: Hattie stands among apple trees in golden evening light.

spreads.text: "I want to see the first star," said Hattie. "Right now!" Her friend Bramble the rabbit smiled. "Let's be patient," he said. "Stars come when they are ready."
spreads.sceneSummary: Hattie looks up at a pink sky while Bramble sits beside her.

spreads.text: Patient? Hattie scrunched her nose. "Patient means waiting kindly," said Bramble, "without fussing."
spreads.sceneSummary: Close-up of Hattie wrinkling her nose and Bramble explaining.

spreads.text: So they waited. Hattie counted the apples. One, two, three, four. The sky turned peach, then lilac.
spreads.sceneSummary: Hattie counts apples on a low branch as the sky changes colour.

spreads.text: A sleepy bee buzzed home. A blackbird sang a last soft song. "Is it time yet?" asked Hattie. "Not yet," said Bramble.
spreads.sceneSummary: A bee flies past and a blackbird sings on a fence post.

spreads.text: Hattie wriggled. Hattie fidgeted. Then she took a slow, deep breath, the way Bramble did. In, and out.
spreads.sceneSummary: Hattie and Bramble breathe slowly together on the grass.

spreads.text: "I can be patient," whispered Hattie. She curled up next to Bramble, warm as a teacup.
spreads.sceneSummary: Hattie curls up beside Bramble under the apple tree.

spreads.text: The lilac sky became deep, soft blue. The orchard went quiet and still.
spreads.sceneSummary: Wide view of the calm orchard at dusk with the two friends small in the grass.

spreads.text: And there it was. One tiny star, twinkling hello. "You waited so patiently," said Bramble. Hattie beamed.
spreads.sceneSummary: Low angle: the first star shines above the friends, who look up smiling.

spreads.text: Hattie yawned a big yawn. "Goodnight, star. Goodnight, Bramble." And she closed her eyes, cosy and happy, under the twinkling sky.
spreads.sceneSummary: Hattie asleep in a nest of leaves, Bramble tucked beside her, one star above.

notes: Read twice against the nothing-scary rule: no danger, no dark places, no one alone.
